name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a junior gold explorer operating in Nevada's Walker Lane gold trend, where it holds a 50% earn-in interest in the Lapon Canyon Gold Project located approximately 40 miles southeast of Yerington, Nevada. The project hosts historical high-grade gold mining with recent drill results including 3.79 g/t Au over 85 metres. The company is advancing toward a maiden NI 43-101 resource estimate targeted for year-end 2026.
